paper_title: VideoLLaMB Long-context Video Understanding with Recurrent Memory   Bridges
caption: Length extrapolation results on EgoSchema dataset.
model_annotation:
This plot illustrates length extrapolation results on the EgoSchema dataset, showing accuracy as a function of the number of input frames for four different methods. The x-axis represents "Number of Frames" on a linear scale, ranging from approximately 8 to 64, with tick labels at intervals of 10 (10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60). The y-axis represents "Accuracy (%)" on a linear scale, ranging from approximately 39 to 54, with tick labels at intervals of 2 (40, 42, 44, 46, 48, 50, 52, 54).

The blue line with circle markers and a dashed line style, labeled "Ours (Dynamic Seg)," starts at approximately 53.1% accuracy at 8 frames, rises to about 54.0% at 16 frames, remains near 53.9% at 32 frames, and stays relatively flat at approximately 53.8% at 64 frames, exhibiting a largely stable trend across the frame range. The green line with circle markers and a dashed line style, labeled "Ours (Static 4-Seg)," begins at approximately 52.6% at 8 frames, increases to about 53.6% at 16 frames, reaches approximately 53.9% at 32 frames, and remains near 53.8% at 64 frames, showing a slight upward trend that plateaus. The orange line with square markers and a solid line style, labeled "PLLaVA (DP 8)," starts at approximately 45.0% at 8 frames, decreases to about 43.0% at 16 frames, drops further to approximately 41.0% at 32 frames, and continues declining to about 39.4% at 64 frames, exhibiting a consistent downward trend. The red line with square markers and a solid line style, labeled "PLLaVA (DP 16)," begins at approximately 45.7% at 16 frames, decreases to about 43.9% at 32 frames, and continues declining to approximately 42.3% at 64 frames, also showing a steady downward trend across the measured range.
